title: fix(imports): split out templating from ./utils
body:
**Summary**

Put everything related to `helpers` out of the `utils` folder, as not every bundler tree shakes correctly (metro for example)

**Result**

This should fix https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch/issues/3632 as well, as renderTemplate will no longer be in the imported path for connectors (react instantsearch hooks), and thus no errors can be in it either
